question:
Choose the word that can substitute the given group of words.

A diagram showing the path of planets
solution:
The correct answer is** 'Option 3'** i.e. **'Zodiac'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The most appropriate substitute for the group of words "A diagram showing the path of planets" would indeed be: **'Zodiac'**
 
• Zodiac refers to an area of the sky that extends approximately 8° north or south (as measured in celestial latitude) of the ecliptic, the apparent path of the Sun across the celestial sphere over the course of the year. 
 
• The paths of the Moon and visible planets remain close to the ecliptic, within the belt of the zodiac.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Zodiac'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Platitude:** This word is used to refer to a remark or statement that may be true, but is uninteresting and unoriginal because it has been said so many times before.(घिसा-पिटा विचार).
 
• **Horoscope: **A horoscope is an astrological chart or diagram representing the positions of the Sun, Moon, planets, and other celestial entities at a specific time, which is used to interpret their meaning or impact on one's life. In Hindi, it is called 'kundali' (कुंडली).
 
• **Planetarium:** A Planetarium is a theatre built primarily for presenting educational and entertaining shows about astronomy and the night sky, or for training in celestial navigation. (ग्रहमंडल).
